Name: Pink Mist Milkcandy
Author: WhiteShu
Description:
关于本模组

一套以“奶油风”为主题的甜美风服饰套装，基于 Fashion Sense 框架运行，采用四倍高清像素绘制，让你的农夫在星露谷中也能拥有软萌梦幻的穿搭体验！

本模组包含：

· 🎀 1 款发型 — 温柔甜美的奶糖系发型
· 👑 1 款头饰 — 精致可爱的蝴蝶结/发饰
· 👗 2 款裙子 — 粉雾主题四倍高清连衣裙

两套裙子均以柔和的粉雾色调为主，搭配细腻的高清像素质感，甜美又不失优雅。无论是日常农场生活还是参加节日庆典，都能让你成为星露谷最亮眼的风景！

使用说明

1. 确保已安装 SMAPI 和 Fashion Sense
2. 下载本模组后，将压缩包解压至 Stardew Valley/Mods 文件夹
3. 进入游戏后，使用 Fashion Sense 的换装界面穿戴即可

前置需求

· SMAPI
· Fashion Sense (FS)

本模组为纯外观美化，不修改任何游戏机制，可随时安装/卸载。

English Description

Pink Mist Candy — 4x HD Outfit Set

About This Mod

Pink Mist Candy is a sweet and dreamy outfit set featuring a soft pink mist aesthetic. Built on the Fashion Sense framework and rendered in 4x HD pixel art, this mod brings a charming, candy-like vibe to your farmer's wardrobe in Stardew Valley!

This Mod Includes:

· 🎀 1 Hairstyle — a soft, sweet candy-themed hairdo
· 👑 1 Head Accessory — a delicate and adorable bow / hairpiece
· 👗 2 Dresses — pink mist themed 4x HD gowns

Both dresses feature a gentle pink mist color palette with fine HD pixel details — sweet, elegant, and perfect for any occasion. Whether you're tending to your farm or celebrating at a festival, you'll be the most eye-catching farmer in the valley!

How to Use

1. Make sure you have SMAPI and Fashion Sense installed
2. Download and extract the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
3. In-game, use the Fashion Sense dressing menu to equip the items

Requirements

· SMAPI
· Fashion Sense (FS)

This is a purely cosmetic mod. It does not alter any game mechanics and can be safely installed or uninstalled at any time.
